name: Tázlár (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tázlár (a white shield with a blue chief, reeds, a church and waves) above a scroll inscribed TÁZLÁR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
